name: telegram-auto-compaction
description: M22 B1: oversized history trips the AUTOMATIC compaction path in run_loop (not the /compact sentinel). That turn then opens with one shell tool call, so a live Task HUD frame posts — and the B1 one-shot 'history auto-compacted' note rides its summary EXACTLY ONCE (the Wave 0 baseline pinned the pre-B1 silence).
